profile.headline: Software Engineer at scientist.com
profile.summary:
I'm currently a software developer at Scientist.com. I have experience with languages & frameworks like Javascript, Ruby on Rails, React, SQL, HTML & CSS as well as databases like PostgreSQL & Active Record. I love getting into a solid flow state with a code problem, and my favorite things about being a developer are the constant opportunity to push the limits of my knowledge & the ability to learn something unique every day.

I come from a marketing background, and I have extensive experience designing websites with tools like Wordpress (Divi & Beaver Builder), Webflow, Squarespace, Wix, & Shopify. I have worked in client-facing roles in the agency setting, and I know the importance of delivering a result that captivates the end user. These past roles have driven my interest in creating satisfying user experiences & taking my knowledge a step further by learning to code. 

My goal is to keep learning & growing as a developer by applying my knowledge in an immersive, challenging role at a company that supports this kind of growth. Feel free to reach out to me to connect!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: User Experience (UX) · Software Design · Software Development · UI · Ruby on Rails

positions.title: Mid-Level Software Engineer I
positions.description:
• Designed and developed full-stack React and Ruby-on-Rails applications for a dev consultancy, delivering high-quality solutions to meet client objectives
• Enhanced Scientist.com's Webstore, a NextJS marketplace application, by integrating with a rails-based API, improving user experience and driving increased sales
• Created a reusable component library using Storybook, streamlining development across multiple projects and ensuring consistent design and functionality
• Implemented critical frontend and backend updates for clients within strict deadlines, ensuring efficient delivery of key features and resolving issues promptly
• Led the development of various projects including a Digital Library app, a React-in-Rails research application manager, and our team/company website, demonstrating leadership and expertise in software engineering

positions.title: Junior Software Developer
positions.description: Skills: Ruby · JavaScript · React.js · GitHub · Ruby on Rails · HTML · SASS

positions.title: Software Engineer in Training
positions.description:
• Completed intensive web development bootcamp with 480+ hours of direct coding experience
• Proficient in building Javascript, Ruby, and React applications
• Implemented test-driven development for full-stack React-on-Rails projects
• Collaborated effectively through pair and mob programming to deliver high-quality solutions

positions.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
positions.description:
• Developed visually stunning websites for clients using Wordpress and Divi to enhance their digital presence
• Led a successful brand reboot project from start to finish, resulting in a refreshed identity for the client
• Effectively communicated strategies and managed client expectations through presentations and regular interactions

positions.title: Marketing Manager
positions.description:
• Led a marketing initiative at brainsfeed, an on-demand research platform serving multiple industries.
• Generated high-quality, actionable research and insights for companies in need of information.
• Cultivated a vast network of analysts and domain experts to provide instant access to expertise.
• Enhanced companies' decision-making processes by delivering verifiable research results.
• Facilitated seamless communication from questions to answers through the brainsfeed platform.

positions.title: Digital Marketing Content Designer/Account Manager
positions.description:
• Produced SEO-optimized blogs, enhancing organic search rankings and driving traffic to client websites
• Developed visually appealing print/sales collateral, infographics, eBooks, and white papers for effective client marketing campaigns
• Implemented automated social media, blog, and email processes using Hubspot, streamlining communication channels and maximizing efficiency
• Executed targeted e-mail campaigns and newsletters through Mailchimp and Hubspot, resulting in increased customer engagement and conversions
• Crafted persuasive paid social, Google search & display ads, boosting client brand visibility and generating leads
• Utilized Google Analytics & SEMrush to gauge account performance, enabling data-driven decision making and optimization

positions.title: Marketing Associate
positions.description:
• Independently managed and executed multi-channel marketing strategies for a remote real estate company.
• Created engaging content for property listings, social media platforms, and email campaigns using Canva and Adobe Suite.
• Developed and optimized targeted email campaigns through Mailchimp to reach specific audiences.
• Ensured the seamless operation of WordPress website, listing systems, marketing projects, and social media accounts.
• Curated and scheduled captivating posts on Instagram, Facebook, and Twitter utilizing Later.
• Successfully analyzed and managed paid advertising campaigns on Facebook and Instagram.
• Coordinated advertisements with local print marketing sources, maximizing exposure and brand recognition.

positions.title: Business Development Representative
positions.description:
• Proactively initiated contact with outbound prospects to effectively drive and cultivate new business opportunities.
• Consistently demonstrated a strong work ethic by reaching out to an average of 100+ leads per day, showcasing exceptional dedication and efficiency.
• Skillfully exceeded established quotas for booked meetings, leveraging strategic approaches and persuasive communication to consistently achieve exceptional results.

positions.title: Trip Leader/Coordinator & Virtual Marketing Assistant
positions.description:
• Lead 14-day adventure tours from northern to southern Vietnam, managing up to 25 guests
• Built and maintained internal and external client relationships by coordinating all aspects of the tours with representatives from a local company
• Coordinated personalized excursions, experiences, or transportation for guests
• Interacted with customers from all over the world
• Responsible for trip logistics with great attention to detail
• Handled difficult situations as they arise in a country with a strong language barrier and high level of disorganization
• Monitored customer feedback through guest engagement and trip summary reports
• Adapted customer feedback to ensure satisfaction and modify future tours for continuous improvement
• Created and curated all Vietnam-related Social Media and Web content
• Created print marketing materials for on-site locations to attract clientele to future tours

positions.title: Yoga Instructor
positions.description:
• Led yoga classes in diverse locations across Southeast Asia, India, and California, ensuring a transformative experience for participants.
• Acquired expertise in Ashtanga, Hatha, and Iyengar styles through comprehensive training at the esteemed Association for Yoga and Meditation in Rishikesh, India.
• Earned RYT 200 certification, validating proficiency as a professional yoga instructor.
-RYT 200

positions.title: Bartender
positions.description:
-Worked at two high-volume bars with the same owners.
-Successfully and swiftly served up to 300 customers on any given night, and up to 700 during special events such as Fiesta, graduation, alumni weekend, and holidays.
-Developed expertise in safely serving customers, mixing and recommending drinks, maintaining knowledge of all bar promotions and drink prices, and ensuring that the bar is always well stocked for faster and more efficient work.

company.name: The Study Hall Bar & O’Malley’s Irish Pub

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
-Handled all incoming calls with a pleasant and professional voice and responded to inquiries from customers.
-Provided supervision of the gym and independently managed the establishment when the owner was not present.
-Ordered supplies and coordinated weekly services for the gym.
-Managed new membership applications, recorded monthly guest payments using excel, and professionally responded to incoming emails.
-Supported the owner and handled extra projects and errands whenever needed.

positions.title: Art and Design Intern
positions.description:
-Fact checked and edited articles and ads for a popular luxury magazine in Santa Barbara.
-Took on a large project to organize, standardize and consolidate data and images from previous magazine editions so they would be easily accessible on the company server.
-Utilized photoshop and inDesign to perfect images and layouts for print. 
-Helped with organization and logistics of photoshoots.

volunteerExperiences.description: I volunteered with a program called SLV.Global, which aims to bolster the lack of resources and staff at mental health institutions and hospitals in Sri Lanka, promote community education, and mitigate the widespread stigma against mental and physical disabilities. I also taught community English classes to both children and adults.
